heroTitle: Build a resume for your next application
heroDescription: Build, customize, and optimize your resume professionally with the help of AI.

editor.title: AI-Powered Resume Writing
editor.desc: Use AI to strengthen weak bullets while keeping verified facts intact, with a local readiness check that updates as you edit.

bullets.0: AI rewrites vague bullets for clarity while preserving verified facts
bullets.1: Local resume readiness updates with every edit
bullets.2: One-click enhancement for any section of your resume

tailoring.title: Precision Resume Tailoring
tailoring.desc: Paste a job description and review an AI-assisted rewrite grounded in your resume facts. Compare every proposed change before saving it.

bullets.0: Automatically matches keywords from any job description
bullets.1: Before/after comparison shows exactly what changed
bullets.2: Improves job-description keyword alignment without guaranteeing selection

portfolio.title: Public Portfolio Website
portfolio.desc: Turn your resume into a beautiful personal site with themes, projects, and a shareable link — zero design skills needed.

bullets.0: Reflects your latest saved resume details
bullets.1: Shareable link with a custom slug
bullets.2: Themed layouts that update with one click

interview.title: AI Interview Practice
interview.desc: Practice role-relevant interview questions and review AI feedback on each answer. Treat the feedback as coaching, not a hiring prediction.

bullets.0: Browser voice input — speak naturally when supported
bullets.1: AI scores each answer and gives specific tips
bullets.2: Practice any industry, role, or question type

tracker.title: Kanban Job Tracker
tracker.desc: Visualize every application at a glance. Drag cards across your pipeline and never lose track of an opportunity.

bullets.0: Kanban board with drag-and-drop pipeline stages
bullets.1: Status history so you always know where things stand
bullets.2: Analytics show your application funnel at a glance

arabicResumeDescription: Create, customize, and optimize your resume with AI helper.
heroSubheading: AI that helps you build, tailor, and prepare for your next application.
trustTitle: Privacy controls built into the product
trustSubtitle: Clear controls and disclosures for stored data, public pages, and AI requests.

trustItems.hiddenEmailTitle: Your email stays hidden from bots
trustItems.hiddenEmailBody: Contact info on your portfolio is shielded from automated scrapers. Only real visitors clicking the button can reach you.
trustItems.controlVisibilityTitle: You control who sees your portfolio
trustItems.controlVisibilityBody: One toggle makes your portfolio public or private. No approval steps, no extra hoops.
trustItems.aiNoSpamTitle: Public AI access is session-scoped and rate-limited
trustItems.aiNoSpamBody: Portfolio AI requests use short-lived sessions and abuse controls that reduce unauthorized usage. No online control can promise that abuse is impossible.
trustItems.resumeDataYoursBody: Your resume is private by default. When you explicitly request AI help, the disclosed content is sent to the configured AI provider to generate that response; WiseResume does not use it to train its own models.

footerSecureNotice: Protected by account access controls and encrypted connections
unfairAdvantage: One workspace for your job search.

wisehire.subheading: Organize hiring workflows and request AI-assisted evidence summaries and job-description drafts, with recruiter review required.

brief.label: Brief Generator
brief.desc: AI drafts a structured candidate brief from CV and role evidence, with an evidence-alignment estimate, supported evidence, questions to verify, and interview prompts for recruiter review.

jd.label: JD Writer
jd.desc: AI drafts a job description from supplied facts for a recruiter to verify before publishing.

bulk.label: Bulk Resume Review
bulk.desc: Upload multiple CVs and review source-ordered evidence summaries. AI does not make the hiring decision.

pool.label: Talent Pool
pool.desc: Search candidates your organization is authorized to retain and consider for future roles.

pipeline.label: Pipeline Board
pipeline.desc: Visualise your full hiring funnel with drag-and-drop kanban. Every candidate, every stage, every status — at a glance.

featureTicker.atsScoreDesc: A local section-completeness check that shows what to finish next; it is not an employer ATS score.
featureTicker.coverLettersDesc: Draft role-specific cover letters from your verified resume and job details.
featureTicker.applicationTrackerDesc: Track application stages, follow-ups, goals, and response trends.
